channel.title: US Top News and Analysis

item.title: OpenAI boss Sam Altman spells out how and why the AI industry wants to slow down: 'We could lose control'
item.description: OpenAI's chief has made comments detailing how AI safety frameworks and a slowdown could work, as the industry unites behind concerns.

item.title: Iran says it destroyed U.S. advanced drone over Hormuz as Middle East conflict intensifies
item.description: Iran said it downed an advanced American drone over the Strait of Hormuz, as Tehran and Washington trade warnings and strikes with no sign of de-escalation.

item.title: Why the election could make Washington's looming next fiscal crisis harder
item.description: Some in the GOP are already disavowing raising the debt ceiling absent deep spending cuts as the national debt balloons past $40 trillion.

item.description: These are the stocks posting the largest moves premarket.

item.title: Clarity Act faces make-or-break Senate vote on Tuesday as crypto industry pushes for bill
item.description: A Senate vote on Tuesday is a put-up-or-shut-up moment for the Clarity Act crypto bill, scheduled by Majority Leader John Thune, R-S.D.

item.title: Trump urges Ukraine to stop ‘knocking out’ Russian oil refineries as U.S. diesel hits record
item.description: U.S. diesel prices have surpassed $6 a gallon for the first time ever as the Ukraine and Iran wars drive broader energy supply concerns.

item.title: LA Clippers owner Steve Ballmer apologizes over team sanctions
item.description: Ballmer said that the team is complying with the penalties, has paid the fines, and is "moving forward."

item.title: Cadbury cut two months off its supply chain lead time for a key chocolate-bar ingredient in one move
item.description: Mondelez is expanding its chocolate manufacturing operations in Malaysia, with the company also seeing further room for growth across Southeast Asia.

item.title: Brent crude tops $108 after Saudi Arabia shuts down critical pipeline that bypasses Strait of Hormuz
item.description: Saudi Arabia has faced escalating attacks from Iran-allied militant groups in recent days.

item.title: Satellite images show extent of damage to Saudi Arabia’s oil pipeline that bypasses Strait of Hormuz
item.description: Saudi Arabia temporarily shut the roughly 750-mile pipeline as attacks threaten a key alternative to the Strait of Hormuz.

item.title: Taxing high earners to help fund Social Security gains bipartisan attention — what it could mean for benefits
item.description: With Social Security due to reach a funding shortfall in six years, more lawmakers are opening up to the idea of taxing high earners to help fund the program.

item.title: General Motors has an 'underappreciated' growth driver, UBS says
item.description: The investment bank has a buy rating on the automotive stock.

item.title: Novo Nordisk rebrands to 'Novo,' unveils corporate changes as it fights for obesity market share
item.description: The Danish drugmaker called the changes the beginning of a new chapter for the company, which faces stiff competition from Eli Lilly.

item.title: Larry Ellison nixes plan to offload up to $7.5 billion worth of Oracle stock
item.description: Oracle founder Larry Ellison has canceled his plan to sell up to $7.5 billion worth of stock in the software company.

item.title: Up 3,600%, this freight fund has posted the biggest gains of all on Iran war oil shock
item.description: The U.S.-Iran war has caused oil prices to surge and added to freight stress from tariffs, but no shipping trade has boomed quite like crude oil tanker futures.

item.title: GM plans U.S. battery development as Trump's DOT attacks Ford for China ties
item.description: Most battery cells currently rely on raw materials from China. GM is seeking to establish domestic supply chains both for EVs and energy storage.

item.title: OpenAI rules out IPO this year as Altman, Musk & Amodei warn AI is moving too fast
item.description: Altman's IPO comments and Amodei's public call for more careful pacing of AI development cap a week of loud AI warnings.

item.title: College students feel more pressure to be perfect. Experts explain why
item.description: College students report rising perfectionism. Researchers point to economic pressure and inequality, while experts cite social comparison.

item.title: Jim Cramer questions Anthropic CEO's slowdown manifesto and puts forth an action plan
item.description: While I have grown tired of his endless proclamations, Dario Amodei does raise points that will impact many stocks if the spending curb proceeds.

item.title: Washington scrambles to meet calls for AI guardrails while the window to act closes
item.description: The House is scheduled to be sent home in the coming days until after November's midterm elections, leaving a narrow window to pass any form of AI regulation.

item.title: Debt relief vs. credit counseling: Which is better?
item.description: Debt relief and credit counseling both help consumers climb out of debt. But they have different requirements, costs and drawbacks.

item.title: India’s retail inflation hits 4.8% in August, rises for 10th straight month
item.description: India's inflation in August accelerated for the tenth month straight to 4.82% in August amid rising food and fuel prices.

item.title: NFL and midterm elections set up prediction markets for a critical fall season
item.description: The 2025 football season and 2024 presidential election pushed prediction markets into the prominence they enjoy today.

item.title: U.S. Treasury yields are steady as 10-year closes in on 5% ahead of Fed rates decision
item.description: The 10-year Treasury yield is closing in on 5%, a level last touched in October 2023. Strategists say the drivers behind higher yields are more important.

item.title: The wages of American workers are under pressure. AI's potential role is drawing more attention
item.description: Wage growth for workers has slowed and is struggling to keep up with inflation, drawing attention to AI's potential role even as evidence remains incomplete.

item.title: Yen appreciation has carry-trade seekers looking at these two currencies
Prediction markets are becoming more professionalized, but also harder to beat
item.description: The institutionalization of prediction markets threatens to erode the edge of skilled traders who earn off mispricing and market inefficiencies, experts say.

item.title: Shein shares fall 10% amid urgent recall of contact-lens cleaner by Australia, New Zealand
item.description: Shein's Hong Kong-listed shares fell as much as 10%, amid news that a contact lens product has been recalled urgently due to worries of contamination.

item.title: Baker Hughes sees no slowdown in energy projects despite higher rates as AI buildouts stoke LNG demand
item.description: Baker Hughes has yet to see higher borrowing costs slow investment in major energy projects.
